Hello, my friends. I can't believe it's already another month. Sorry that I didn't update on X and Pixiv this month. I didn't post any previews and didn't even notice that my X got suspended a few times. I've been traveling away and back for work during this period, very exhausting, so I got around a week with my hands not touching anything on my computer. This chapter is not finished yet, and the story is also unfinished. Giving it another week or two, and I'll post the finished work. Thanks.

大家好。真是时间飞逝啊，不敢相信又过了一个月。很抱歉这个月没时间在X和Pixiv上更新，没发任何预览图，甚至都没注意到X账号被封了几次。这个月我出差了一趟，累的要死，所以大概有一周时间都没碰过自家电脑。这一部故事还没完成，文字也还没写完，可能得再过至少一两周吧。届时我会发布完成的作品。谢谢！

---------------------------------------------------------

The IF story is based on Dr.Takemi Tae's side story from P5, where she experimented on Joker and developed a new, superior medicine for her patient. Our story diverged from there, and her medicine was robbed by the boss of the hospital where she had previously worked. The boss had his connections with the yakuza, who had been benefiting from their own medical business, and Takemi Tae is not only a rebellious doctor but a business obstacle.

这个IF故事基于《P5》中武见妙的支线剧情。通过对Joker进行的实验搜集了数据，最终为一位小女孩患者研发出一种更先进的特效药。我们的故事从这里开始走偏，研发药物的消息走漏了，她之前任职的医院的黑心院长带着一群人来抢走了她的成果。这位院长与黑帮有牵连，而黑帮和医院勾结，一直从自己的医疗业务中攉娶高额的利益。武见妙现在对黑帮来说已经不再仅仅是一名叛逆的医生了，更是他们做生意的绊脚石。

The yakuza destroyed Tae's medicine samples, destroyed her office and lab, and eventually decided to destroy her too. The perverted ex-boss decided to use a large amount of liquid nitrogen to kill her...Takemi was shocked to see the container of liquid nitrogen; her medical background instantly told her brain that she's gonna suffer a horrific fate from contacting the liquid, tissues will instantly die, become glass-like and fracture, then it dies forever... However, her smart, rebellious, rightous head didn't know that it would be the first part to be submerged, while she's being raped from behind.

黑帮销毁了武见妙的药剂样本，摧毁了她的办公室和实验室，最终决定将她一并除掉。那个变态的前院长在她的实验室里发现了大量液氮，决定用她自己的设备来杀死她……当看到装着液氮的隔热罐被拿出来之后，武见妙在恐惧中浑身止不住地颤抖；她的医学背景瞬间从大脑中调出警告：一旦直接接触这种液体，她将会遭受可怕的命运，人体会变得像玻璃一样，组织迅速坏死，碎裂，永无修复的可能。只是她眼下并不知道，自己聪慧，正直又叛逆的脑袋，会是第一个被浸入液氮的部分。而她火辣的屁股会同时被人从背后狠狠插入。

-----------------------------------------------------

I like this kind of straightforward story; I often put myself in the shoes of the decision makers: if I'm the ex-boss man who's in control of Tae Takemi's final fate, I'd make the same decision of using her own equipment to kill her. Sometimes it's good to just fulfill an impulse to kill without much torture. Anyway, I wished to explore the frozen shattering for the first time, and it turns out to be quite interesting, but a little hard to master for realism. The frost effect is hard to lay out, and the shattering effect itself is also difficult. I think the final result is pretty good, and i regret that I don't have more time to do some images about the internal trauma. But anyway, I hope you enjoy this month's content. And thank you again for your constant support. I can not do this for this long without you guys!

Love you all！

我喜欢这种直截了当的故事，如果我自己就是院长大人，在掌握到武见妙的生杀大权之时，我应该就会做出这个决定。有时候，顺从杀戮的冲动，随便用手边能找到的东西来处刑，也是挺好的。总之，这是我第一次尝试探索“冰冻粉碎”的效果，结果发现还挺有意思，但要画出那种真实感还是有点难 。冰霜效果很难画得比较真实，软硬组织交接的地方一直想不明白怎么区别，碎裂效果本身也颇具难度。我觉得最终效果还不错吧，只是遗憾没能抽出更多时间来制作一些关于内部创伤的画面，比如脑是怎么冻结的。

不过，无论如何，希望你们喜欢本月的内容。再次感谢大家一直以来的支持。爱你们唷！
